verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense claims that every transaction is "controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant" and supports budgets, and the pricing page lists custom approval policies, so there is a thin first-party basis for policy-controlled spend. The detailed approval-policy docs, however, cover AP bills rather than expenses. missing for 10: documented expense-policy rules by category, role, and context; documented auto-approval of in-policy expenses; exception-only routing to human approvers; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can codify our expense policy — limits by category, role, and context — so in-policy expenses auto-approve and only exceptions reach a human
